problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 9 delivery routes through 9 distribution hubs.

Each route consists of a sequence of stops represented as (Hub, Duration) pairs, where each pair specifies the hub where the truck must stop and the time required for unloading/loading. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which stops must be visited.

Route details:
* R1 follows: (H9, 8) → (H6, 5) → (H2, 4) → (H7, 9) → (H1, 10) → (H3, 4) → (H4, 2) → (H8, 8) → (H5, 4)
* R2 follows: (H6, 2) → (H7, 8) → (H3, 7) → (H8, 8) → (H1, 6) → (H2, 10) → (H4, 5) → (H9, 8) → (H5, 3)
* R3 follows: (H5, 2) → (H1, 7) → (H4, 4) → (H6, 5) → (H8, 2) → (H7, 7) → (H3, 10) → (H9, 5) → (H2, 9)
* R4 follows: (H1, 2) → (H9, 2) → (H4, 9) → (H6, 10) → (H7, 3) → (H3, 5) → (H8, 6) → (H5, 8) → (H2, 9)
* R5 follows: (H4, 6) → (H7, 3) → (H8, 2) → (H2, 9) → (H5, 6) → (H6, 10) → (H9, 4) → (H1, 2) → (H3, 9)
* R6 follows: (H2, 1) → (H8, 7) → (H5, 5) → (H7, 9) → (H4, 6) → (H3, 4) → (H9, 10) → (H1, 6) → (H6, 5)
* R7 follows: (H2, 5) → (H8, 8) → (H7, 1) → (H9, 6) → (H1, 6) → (H5, 4) → (H6, 6) → (H3, 6) → (H4, 6)
* R8 follows: (H7, 6) → (H4, 1) → (H1, 7) → (H8, 3) → (H5, 2) → (H3, 3) → (H2, 1) → (H9, 9) → (H6, 5)
* R9 follows: (H4, 5) → (H6, 1) → (H2, 2) → (H5, 8) → (H1, 5) → (H7, 7) → (H3, 4) → (H9, 3) → (H8, 8)

Each stop must be completed without interruption once it begins, and each hub can only accommodate one truck at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all stops at the hubs so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
